content.short: AGNI is a Mantle native DEX that uses concentrated liquidity pools to support swaps and liquidity provision.
content.description: AGNI is a decentralized exchange built for Mantle that centers its trading experience on concentrated liquidity. Its official product materials describe an AMM where liquidity providers choose price ranges so capital can be deployed more efficiently than in broader pool models. The platform focuses on spot trading and liquidity management inside the Mantle ecosystem, while its website also points to launchpad and ve tokenomics components as part of the broader roadmap. For Mantle users, AGNI serves as one of the network's native venues for swapping assets and deploying onchain liquidity.
